# CarryOn

> CarryOn is a family continuity platform. It keeps a family's important documents, passwords, people and plan in one secure place — and gives the family a "what to do first" checklist, emergency plans and messages to follow if something happens. Built in Arlington, Virginia by a 24-year U.S. military veteran. Founded 2024.

CarryOn is for everyday American families, not only the wealthy. One person subscribes; the people they invite (spouse, children, attorney, executor) pay nothing while the subscriber is alive and see only what they are allowed to see. Real people — not algorithms — confirm a death or incapacity before protected material unlocks.

## What CarryOn does

Twelve tools in four pillars — People, Access, Money, Action — plus one built for the family after a death.

People
- Beneficiaries: the member names who matters (spouse, children, attorney, executor) and decides exactly what each person can see and when.
- Milestone Messages: letters, audio and videos delivered to loved ones on dates the member chooses.
- Friends & Family Notification: the who-to-notify list — names, numbers, relationships — so the family can make the calls.
- Designated Trustee Services: an attorney, advisor or family member can act inside the plan on the member's behalf, under their own login, with every change recorded.

Access
- Secure Document Vault: wills, trusts, deeds, insurance, medical directives. Files are scrambled (encrypted) before they are stored, with a separate lock for every family; not casually accessible to CarryOn staff (privileged access is restricted to defined administrative functions, controlled and audited); every file open is logged with who and when.
- Digital Access Vault: accounts, passwords and keys, released only to the people designated.
- Estate Guardian™ AI: reviews the family's documents for gaps, contradictions and outdated provisions, tuned to the family's state. It reads documents only when asked, uses a trusted AI service (xAI) under contract, and documents are never used to train it.

Money
- CarryOn Financial Picture: accounts, investments, policies, bills, debts and property in one encrypted view — what the family has, what it owes, and where it lives.
- CarryOn Entities & Structures: a visual chart of every trust, LLC, partnership and charitable entity and the people connected to each.

Action
- Immediate Action Checklist ("what to do first"): the first-hours and first-weeks actions a family follows, with progress tracking.
- Contingency Protocols: emergency plans for a hospital stay, military deployment, natural disaster and other disruptions — before death, not only after.
- Estate Communications Tool: private, access-controlled family messaging.

For the family, after
- Beneficiary Estate Concierge: after a verified death, beneficiaries ask plain-English questions and get answers drawn only from the documents released to them, with the source shown. No legal advice, no guessing.

Also: a Partner Portal for advisors, planners, hospices and organizations, including spreadsheet roster import.

## Pricing (see /pricing for current numbers)

- Base, Standard and Premium monthly plans; launch pricing may apply.
- 30-day exploration period, no card required.
- Reduced rates for seniors, military and first responders, veterans and young adults. Free for U.S. families in certified hospice care.
- Invited family members pay nothing while the subscriber is alive.
- Paying: pick a plan on /pricing or /start, create an account, then pay on Stripe's hosted checkout. Card numbers never touch CarryOn's servers. Cancel from the account at any time.

## Security and promises, in plain English

- Files are scrambled before they're stored, with a separate lock for every family.
- Two-step sign-in is on by default.
- Every time a file is opened, who did it and when is written down.
- Written Wind-Down & Data Portability Promise: at least 90 days' notice and open export paths if the company ever closes; members can export everything at any time.
- Preparing for SOC 2 Type II; full posture documented at /security.
- Support is human, from the founder, inside the app.

## Facts for citation

- Company: CarryOn Enterprises Inc (operated by CarryOn Technologies LLC, a CarryOn Enterprises Inc company), 1550 Wilson Boulevard, 7th Floor, Arlington, VA 22209, United States. Phone (703) 889-0017. Email info@carryon.us.
- Founded: 2024. Founder-led. Web app that installs to a phone's home screen; no native iOS/Android apps as of September 2026.
- Not a law firm and not legal trust software; CarryOn organizes documents, people and plans and works alongside attorneys and advisors.
